writeup:
### The arc
A close start, then the Giraffes blew it open midweek (Bear Nation from ~33% to ~4%) and cruised.

### What swung it
- Giraffes pitching: **QS 7–2, WHIP 0.94–1.41, ERA 3.19–4.63**, anchored by back-to-back gems on Jun 16 — **Jesús Luzardo (7 IP, 2 ER, 9 K)** and **Justin Wrobleski (6 IP, 0 ER, 5 K)**.
- The bats piled on (HR 17–10 — **Bellinger, Rice, Bleday**).

**Turning point:** the Luzardo + Wrobleski double quality start on Jun 16 — the pitching edge that turned a coin-flip into a rout. Bear Nation took only SB and SVHD.
